items.title: Opening type from plan symbol alone (window vs glazed door)
items.evidence: GF: Urban-only straight widths equal the manual aluminium external-door width; window counts are published COMPLETE
items.proposed_fix: publish the glazed-opening COUNT as complete but its window / door TYPE as BLOCKED unless a sill / head / door-swing / elevation fact proves it (generic OPENING_TYPE_AUTHORITY)

items.title: Column / wall clear height method as a declared, owner-approved rule
items.evidence: manual heights = floor-to-floor - 0.75 m (beam soffit) for columns, 3.6 / 3.4 m for walls
items.proposed_fix: a versioned HEIGHT_METHOD fact (e.g. column = storey height - main beam depth) applied only when the owner approves it; never inferred from the benchmark

items.title: Simple-beam binding: mark beside its band
items.evidence: Urban measured 1 simple band (B24); the manual measures every beam
items.proposed_fix: bind a mark to the parallel band whose breadth equals the scheduled B and whose centre line is within one band width, ambiguity-guarded (refuse when two bands qualify)

items.title: Slab-edge outline + void deduction
items.evidence: manual slab areas 207 / 120 / 45.19 m2; Urban SLAB_OUTLINE_NOT_ESTABLISHED
items.proposed_fix: slab-edge role inference on the structural plans (closed outline on the slab layer, void labels and opening hatches subtracted), beam/slab overlap rule declared

items.title: CURVED_OPENING_MEASUREMENT_POLICY
items.evidence: GF manual 6.57 m is below every Urban arc (closest: inner 6.658 m); 1F manual 3.15 m equals the mean
items.proposed_fix: publish all bases (inner / centre / outer / chord) and let a declared policy pick the commercial basis; do not choose from this benchmark

items.title: Open-zone closure at the GF entrance (reception / dining / saloon)
items.evidence: manual treats the zone as one closed room (137.5 m2) plus a separate entrance room (10.46 m2)
items.proposed_fix: closure only from an owner answer (OQ3-A1) or a proven door / screen symbol; then certify

items.title: Room certification for multi-label and split-label sites
items.evidence: dewaneya, GF master bedroom, 1F laundry / bedrooms are measured by the manual; Urban blocks them
items.proposed_fix: separate label sites by proven single-line partitions / joinery; certify sites whose only issue is an inferred wardrobe box (OQ3-A2)

items.title: Continuous-beam length per floor and per occurrence
items.evidence: the manual reports CBs per floor with drawn lengths; Urban reports one schedule row
items.proposed_fix: report CB occurrences per slab sheet and both length bases (schedule span / measured)

items.title: Blinding / ground slab / ground beams / perimeter strap items
items.evidence: manual carries them; Urban has no item
items.proposed_fix: add the items with source-based extents (footprint offset rule declared) or BLOCKED rows

items.title: Rebar tonnage
items.proposed_fix: SOURCE_IMPOSSIBLE without bar schedules (cutting lengths, laps, hooks); keep fail-closed

items.title: Finish heights / neck height / ground-beam extents
items.evidence: manual heights and round ground-beam lengths are not in the source
items.proposed_fix: SOURCE_IMPOSSIBLE without levels / false-ceiling heights: owner method facts only
